# What NOT to send to the Hugging Face Space, shared by every workflow that
# pushes there (deploy.yml and daily-bhavcopy.yml).
#
# It lives in one file because the two lists drifted and it cost three days of
# stale EOD data: daily-bhavcopy.yml was missing the liquid-glass-bg.jpg line,
# and the Space's pre-receive hook rejects binary files outright --
# "Your push was rejected because it contains binary files" -- so every run
# from 2026-09-07 onwards generated and committed the day's bhavcopy and then
# failed to deliver it. deploy.yml, which had the line, kept working, which is
# why the Space only ever updated when a backend change happened to redeploy.
#
# rsync --exclude-from syntax: one pattern per line, blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' or ';' ignored.

# Repository and tooling
.git
.github
.venv
backend/.venv
backend/venv
frontend/node_modules
test-results
tmp

# Binary assets. The Space refuses these unless they go through Xet/LFS, and
# the backend image has no use for them.
frontend/public/liquid-glass-bg.jpg

# Snapshot caches. Rebuilt on the Space; the 29 MB frontend copy in particular
# has no business in a backend image.
backend/data/free_snapshots.json
backend/data/free_snapshots.json.gz
backend/data/free_snapshots_us.json
backend/data/free_snapshots_us.json.gz
frontend/public/api/free_snapshots.json
frontend/public/api/free_snapshots_us.json

# Runtime caches
backend/data/chart_cache
backend/data/chart_cache_us
backend/data/news_cache
